definition: The sequence of preparing a [play](/term/play) around a neutral objective. The term objective setup can be used in specific, referring to a prepared, high-coordination sequence a team performs before an objective, or in general, referring to the general situation before a neutral objective is contested. The goal of an objective setup is to make the ensuing [contest](/term/contest) easier, through a mixture of meso and [macro](/term/macro) strategies.
